svg.title: Context Window Budget
svg.desc: A single bar represents the context window, split into system prompt and guardrails, tool definitions, few-shot examples, retrieved context, conversation history, and space reserved for model output. Lever 1, retrieved context: sending the full corpus is wasteful because it dilutes relevance and costs tokens; sending only relevant chunks is precise and cheaper. Lever 2, conversation history: if it grows too large, summarize or compact older turns; otherwise keep it as is.
svg.text: Everything competes for one fixed window (e.g. 200K tokens). Two levers move the most.
